lines.beaver: 민지 씨, 오래간만이에요! 요즘 회사 생활 어때요?
lines.beaver_en: Minji, long time no see! How's work life lately?
lines.beaver_roman: Minji ssi, oraeganmanieyo! Yojeum hoesa saenghwal eottaeyo?
lines.en: Long time no see. I'm a bit busy because there's a lot of work.
My home is far, so commuting is a little hard.

lines.beaver_en: What time do you get to work?
lines.learner: 아홉 시에 출근해요. 길이 막혀서 일찍 나와요.
lines.en: I start at nine. Traffic is bad, so I leave early.
lines.roman: Ahop sie chulgeunhaeyo. Giri makyeoseo iljjik nawayo.

lines.en: The president is cheerful, so I like him.

lines.beaver_en: And the department head? Isn't he a bit scary?
lines.learner: 아니요, 부장님이 도움을 많이 주셔서 좋아요.
lines.en: No, he helps me a lot, so I like him.
lines.roman: Aniyo, bujangnimi doumeul mani jusyeoseo joayo.

lines.beaver_en: Did last month's project end well?
lines.learner: 네, 다 같이 해서 잘 끝났어요.
lines.en: Yes, we did it together, so it ended well.
lines.roman: Ne, da gachi haeseo jal kkeunnasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: I heard your pay went up this month?
lines.en: Yes, it went up a little, so I'm really happy.

lines.beaver: 와, 좋겠네요! 쉬는 시간에는 뭐 해요?
lines.beaver_en: Wow, that's great! What do you do on breaks?
lines.beaver_roman: Wa, jokenneyo! Swineun siganeneun mwo haeyo?
lines.learner: 휴게실에 가요. 커피가 맛있어서 자주 가요.
lines.en: I go to the lounge. The coffee is good, so I go often.
lines.roman: Hyugesire gayo. Keopiga masisseoseo jaju gayo.

lines.beaver: 저도 가 볼게요. 아, 점심시간이 다 지나갔네요.
lines.beaver_en: I'll try going too. Oh, lunchtime is almost over.
lines.beaver_roman: Jeodo ga bolgeyo. A, jeomsimsigani da jinaganneyo.
lines.en: Then let's talk again in the break room this afternoon.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 일 너무 많이 하지 마세요!
lines.beaver_en: Sounds good. Don't work too hard!
lines.beaver_roman: Joayo. Il neomu mani haji maseyo!
lines.learner: 고마워요. 바빠서 이만 갈게요. 이따 봐요!
lines.en: Thanks. I'm busy, so I'll go now. See you later!
lines.roman: Gomawoyo. Bappaseo iman galgeyo. Itta bwayo!
